text:
sanjay: Heads up — I'm going to sweep staging flags for telemetry/PII changes now. Plan: enable `flag.pii_log_control` (staging only), set `retention_days=30`, and prefer customer HSM with a graceful fallback to managed KMS. Putting the rollout notes here so ops + security can eyeball.

carla: Quick Q — who’s in the canary audience? internal-only or a % of prod-like traffic?

sanjay: Canary = internal + QA workers (about 8% of staging traffic). Not hitting prod. If that looks good we'll do a small prod canary later (2%).

dan: Does `audit_mode` flip on anything extra? Need to know before enabling for staging.

sanjay: `audit_mode` in soft mode keeps PII anonymized but logs denser traces for debugging. Hard mode would write additional audit events — we are NOT enabling hard for staging.

frank: Want the HSM fallback details — specifically how many retries and the timeout so SRE can set alerts.

sanjay: Retry policy: 3 attempts, exponential backoff (200ms -> 800ms). If HSM is unavailable after retries, we fall back to managed KMS and increment `pii_kms_fallback` metric. Ops will get alerted on > 5 fallback events / 5m.

eve: PR is up with the toggle and guards: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4729 — pinged @carla @frank for review.

carla: I’ll review now. two things to check: 1) the retention TTL config path (should be `redwood.security.pii.retention_days`), 2) that the KMS fallback increments the right metric name.

sanjay: thanks. config snippet we’re applying:
```
redwood:
  security:
    pii:
      flag.pii_log_control: true
      retention_days: 30
      audit_mode: "soft"  # anonymize before logging
      kms_mode: "customer-hsm"  # fallback to managed-kms on errors
      canary: { audience: ["internal", "qa"], prod_canary_pct: 2 }
```

frank: ops alert config I’ll hook into: watch `pii_kms_fallback` counter and `pii_log_error_rate`. Thresholds: fallback >5/5m or error_rate >1% => page. Also add latency SLO: added latency on token operations >200ms => page.

ops-bot: Reminder — runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pii-flag-rollout. Follow rollback steps 2a-2d if page occurs.

deploy-bot: rolling update to `staging` started for service `ingest-telemetry` (image: gcr/redwood/ingest:canary-20260317).

carla: LGTM for code changes. small nit in tests, but not blocking.

sanjay: thanks @carla. I'll wait for @frank to confirm alert hooks then merge & flip the flag in staging. plan: monitor for 30m, then widen canary if stable.

dan: If anybody is AFK, leave a note. I can take first on-call window.

sanjay: assigning monitoring to @dan for first 30m, then @eve for the 1–2h window. Rollback criteria: any internal error spikes >1% or KMS fallback >5 events in 5m or latency spike >200ms. I'll post a rollback command here if triggered.

eve: copying the ops checklist into PR comments now. :thumbsup:

sanjay: merging in 2m. will post final status.
